page.overview:
What is Amulets of Kroog?

The Amulets of Kroog were artifacts created by Urza following designs from the Jalum Tome.

The amulets had calming and healing effects on their wearers and were extremely popular among the temples and populace of Kroog. This contributed greatly to Urza's popularity among his people in the years leading up to the Fall of Kroog, after which Urza did not create any further amulets.

Millennia later, Amulets of Kroog could still be found spread across the world. Around 4100 AR, the woman Ikenet used one such amulet to heal the minotaur Hamu of his wound.
